next.reason: 1985: if INVALID KEY is not specified 'a USE AFTER EXCEPTION procedure must be associated with the file connector and that procedure is executed'. 2023 drops the requirement: §2023:9.1.14 GR3 runs any applicable exception processing statements (USE declaratives, §2023:9.1.12 GR2) and 'If control is returned from those statements or there are no applicable exception processing statements, control is transferred to the end of the input-output statement', and §2023:9.1.14 GR4 'If the INVALID KEY phrase is not specified in the input-output statement and there are no applicable exception processing statements' continues the same way. Looser: a program with neither INVALID KEY nor USE is now conforming; EC-I-O-INVALID-KEY is nonfatal, so no refusal became a fatal exception. The paragraph on no invalid key condition is carried verbatim in GR4's trailing text.
